properties.displayName: [Custom] Kubernetes pods should have required team and environment labels
properties.description: Demonstrates authoring a custom OPA/Rego-backed Azure Policy definition for AKS. Uses the open-source Gatekeeper library's K8sRequiredLabels ConstraintTemplate (https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper-library) to require that every Pod carries the labels supplied in the 'labels' parameter (for example 'team' and 'environment'). The Azure Policy add-on downloads the referenced ConstraintTemplate and syncs it to the cluster as a Gatekeeper CRD.

metadata.description: 'audit' allows a non-compliant resource to be created but flags it as non-compliant. 'deny' blocks the non-compliant resource from being created. 'disabled' turns off the policy.
A list of objects, each with a 'key' (the required label name) and an optional 'allowedRegex' the label's value must match.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to include in policy evaluation. An empty list means all namespaces not explicitly excluded.
